sloka: यथा ऽसौ सम्प्रहृष्टानां वानराणां समुत्थितः ।बहूनां सुमहानादो मेघानामिव गर्जताम् ।व्यक्तं सुमहती प्रीतिरेतेषां नात्र संशयः ।। ६.५१.३ ।।।।
transliteration: yathā 'sau samprahṛṣṭānāṁ vānarāṇāṁ samutthitaḥ ।bahūnāṁ sumahānādo meghānāmiva garjatām ।vyaktaṁ sumahatī prītireteṣāṁ nātra saṁśayaḥ ।। 6.51.3 ।।।।

translations.english: "Many Vanaras have collected together and roared making loud noises just as thunder rumbling clouds. By that there is no doubt that they are very happy. For that reason, even the wide ocean is agitated."
